title: Component multiplier under noise
statement: Let $P$ be a product of $n$ finite probability spaces with strictly positive atom masses, let $S$ be a set of coordinates, let $\rho\in\mathbb R$, and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the product space. At every outcome $x$, the $S$-component of the noise transform of $f$ is $\rho^{|S|}$ times the $S$-component of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a finite product probability space with positive coordinate weights summing to one
$f$ is real-valued on the product space
replaced: Let $P$ be a product of $n$ finite probability spaces with strictly positive atom masses and outcome space $\Omega=\prod_i\Omega_i$, $S\subseteq[n]$, $\rho\in\mathbb R$, and $f:\Omega\to\mathbb R$. The $S$-component of $T_\rho f$ is $\rho^{|S|}f_S$.
